enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +21: Passive: +21 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Upgradeable Item (Temple of Elemental Evil): This item can be upgraded. Bring this item to the Overgrown Workbench in the Temple of Elemental Evil and combine it with Rusty Gilled Mushrooms to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

children.tooltip: Spell Penetration VI: Passive: +6 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Riposte XII: When Missed by an attack: Deals 12 to 48 damage to your attacker. Passive: +6 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +6 Insight bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Acid Lore XIII: Passive: Your Acid spells gain a 23% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

Epic Elemental Evil Set: While wearing both an Elemental Evil Set Item weapon and an Elemental Evil Set Item armor, you gain:+20 Quality bonus to Melee Power+20 Quality bonus to Ranged Power+20 Quality bonus to Universal Spell Power

enchantments.tooltip: Corrosion +150: Passive: +150 Equipment bonus to Acid Spell Power.
